messages:
maria: Pushed Pelagia-int5 (per-channel, no stoch) to staging for the embeddings pipeline. Quick sanity sweep please.
dev: Running recall@1/5/20 + norm-variance on prod-simset-30k. baseline = nebula-emb-v1.
li: include multilingual slice and short (<8 tokens) filter. freeze tokenizer v1.0 for fairness.
eval-bot: Job 120500 queued by dev. seeds=4, microbatches=128.
dev: early scalars: global recall@1 -0.7% abs vs baseline, short recall@1 -3.9% abs, recall@20 ~+0.2%.
li: short bucket looks noisy. can you paste a few top-5s for failed short queries?
dev: sample dump:
q: "where is my order"
baseline top1: "track order status" (cos=0.88)
pelagia top1: "order delivery times" (cos=0.82)
pelagia top2: "track order status" (cos=0.80)
=> looks like top1 swaps, paraphrase-order differences.
maria: top1 swaps, not wholesale semantic drift. short queries have tighter margins so quantization may flip ties.
infra-bot: FYI staging pods running with kv-cache OFF for this test to reduce variability.
dev: tried per-channel bias-correction post-quant: short recall@1 gap reduced 3.9% -> 1.0%.
li: good. perf/cost impact?
maria: cost down ~18% per token; latency p50 roughly +3ms with this config.
dev: also tested selective-fp16 (keep projection layers fp16): short gap ~0.6% but p50 +9ms.
li: both mitigation branches look viable. action items: 1) dev run 100k holdout for bias-corr and selective-fp16; 2) maria curate 25 failing short-case examples for model card; 3) infra add canary fallback rule to nebula-emb-v1.
infra-bot: Canary rule added: fallback_model=nebula-emb-v1 trigger_short_recall1_drop_pct=2.0, evaluation_window=5m.
eval-bot: Holdout jobs 120501 (bias-corr) and 120502 (selective-fp16) queued. ETA ~50m.
dev: note: tokenizer quirks introduced ~12 punctuation-only outliers; filtering them shrinks short gap by ~0.3% abs. will exclude for SLO calc.
li: please produce uMAP delta plots and topk-entropy for the short bucket. cosine-centroid shift is useful.
maria: will attach uMAPs, neighbor-dumps, and recommended tokenizer freeze text in the ticket. also drafting rollback snippet for ops.
dev: uploading cosine-delta heatmaps and neighbor lists when holdouts finish.
maria: if holdouts meet thresholds (recall@1 gap <=1.5% and cost reduction >=15%), plan canary with fallback + 24h norm-variance monitor.
li: +1. keeping thread for follow-ups only.
